findings: All 51 standard images are present with visible finite series; the housing-market residuals are visibly positive and are reported as fixed-price excess demand.

No new qualitative boundary anomaly is visible relative to the original-grid packet. Original full-range wealth axes and crowded income legends remain, so these are diagnostic rather than publication-ready figures.
Numerical convergence conclusions use the complete grid-effect comparison table, not visual similarity alone.
limits: Two-grid stability of receipt effects does not certify convergence of baseline levels, funded equilibria or policy effects.
